name: Watanuki Yumiko
source:
Fighting Style: Baguazhang.
Birthplace / Origin: Fujian, China.
Occupation: Kashima's bodyguard, part-time bouncer (Tatakarasyuka).
Likes / Loves: Grandpa, Kansai-style Shiruko (sweet red bean soup).
Dislikes / Hates: Meat, cigarettes.
Hobbies: Cooking, knitting and ink painting.

The first of Kotoe's bodyguards who specializes in Chinese martial arts. 

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Geo]Wikipedia[/url] and [url=http://fenixware.net/fab/fab_charMain.asp?id=2462&order=0]Fight-A-Base[/url].]
